title: DeHate: A Stable Diffusion-based Multimodal Approach to Mitigate Hate Speech in Images
benchmark_measurement: The paper and its associated benchmark do not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The focus is on mitigating general hate speech in images generated from hateful text prompts.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on general multimodal hate speech mitigation.
